svg.title: Wario Land 3 treasure map: the treasures in the order the Temple hint asks for them, and what each one opens
svg.text: The 100 treasures in the order the Temple hint asks for them (EventTreasures), and what each opens. Generated by tools/treasure_map.py.
= the chest's colour + the level it is in
opens paths in: same level, new reach
Stage 1: north side, until the west side opens
Stage 2: west side, until the south side opens
Stage 3: south side, until the east side opens
Stage 4: all four sides, up to the Gold Music Box

text.tspan: opens paths in N5, S2, E2
opens paths in N2, N6, W1, W6
brings daytime to the east side
opens paths in S1, S5, E1
opens paths in N4, W5, S4
opens paths in W4, E3, E7

svg.text: After the Gold Music Box: the rest, hinted once the game is cleared

text.tspan: puts the wheels on the cart
opens the door to the sky

svg.text: and 27 more that open nothing: crayons, gems, crests and other collectibles (numbers 49, 51, 52...)
